Subject: Follow-up: demo recording & slides — 15-minute Q&A if helpful?

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through how PraxisHealth might use Redwood for clinical note summarization and embedding search. I promised to drop the recording and the deck — both are attached and also linked below. Short recap: 

- What we demoed: live transcription -> summary generation -> embeddings for search, and a small example of policy masking for PHI-sensitive fields.
- What's low-effort: turnkey ingestion + preconfigured summarization prompts (we can tune these quickly).
- What's likely to take time: aligning on retention and KMS integration for longer-term storage.

If helpful, we can do a quick 15-minute Q&A where I bring Priyom (solutions) to answer integration questions. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 1/12 10:00–10:15
- Tue 1/12 15:30–15:45
- Wed 1/13 09:00–09:15

If none of those work, tell me a day/time that does and we'll accommodate. Also curious about priority — is this still something Praxis is looking to evaluate in the next 2–4 weeks, or should we revisit later?

Links/attachments:
- Recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/demo_recording_20270110
- Slides: praxis_demo_slides_20270110.pdf (attached)

Attachments: [praxis_demo_slides_20270110.pdf, demo_recording_20270110.mp4]

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
